title: ViewerAnswer
description: The answer the phone companion shows. value is computed by code from the cited evidence, never by a model; the Companion agent only words text. Mirrors ninety.agents.contracts.Answer.

status.description: Only verified answers show their text; held means still being checked.

metric.description: The stat the value is, e.g. distance_m or top_speed_kmh.

evidence.description: Event and fact ids behind the answer.

t_from.description: Start of the stretch of match the answer covers, in seconds.

visual.description: Optional: what the phone draws beside the answer, taken by code from the first cited insight fact that has one; null or absent draws nothing.

names.description: Optional: how to label each player the visual or text shows, by track id (a gated team-sheet name or a role, never an id).

spoken.description: Optional: the answer as it is spoken to a screen-reader user or by the Describer, with no visual reference.

headline.description: Optional: the direct answer in a few words, by code from the question's kind and the cited facts: a name for who or which (the role when the name is not confident), a number with its unit for how many or how fast, a place for where; the supporting number stays in text. Null: the phone shows none.

how.description: Optional: how the answer's figures are made, for the phone's How-we-know tab: the method, and the hit rate where docs/EVALUATION.md measures one. Never part of text. Null: the phone shows none.
